t: Said by people who have already been given everything
a: فَيَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
m: He will say: shall I not give you something better than this? They will say: our Lord, what is better than this? He will say: I bestow My pleasure upon you, and I will never be displeased with you after it.
